author: hasanthehun
text:
no one should ever ignore that Mahershala’s longtime agent was caught in a group chat saying “screw the left kill all” and complaining that WME was "weak" on firing artists speaking out about Gaza. 

Mahershala was one of the founding signers and supporters for Artists4Ceasefire.
